entities.name: Akua Kuenyehia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Akua Kuenyehia is a Ghanaian academic and lawyer who served as judge of the International Criminal Court (ICC) from 2003 to 2015. She also served as First Vice-president of the Court. She was one of the three female African judges at the ICC.
